name: Maria Naruse
source:
Maria is [url=/c152961]Mio[/url]'s maid, but she has never seen her that way. To her, she is more like a younger sister who is always nearby. [url=/c152960]Jin[/url] adopted her, and she became part of my family, just as close as Mio. Honestly she even reminds [url=/c144566]me[/url] of [url=/c144575]Nixie[/url] — both are very sweet and shameless.

[In game description]
